tests.name: Single Excel file loads with ~100 products (v2), stores and stock
9 templates (PRJ-01 … PRJ-09) with rule IDs, quantity rules and review status/date fields
Hang a 20 kg shelf on concrete → validated list with materials, tools, safety gear
Unknown wall type → stop, no wall plugs suggested (shelf and picture)
Wall type not answered → no list, question asked first
Customer picks the 4 × 40 screw (fits 6 mm plugs) for 8 mm plugs → detected as incompatible
Cheaper look-alike screw (same name/size, no compatibility data) is never auto-selected
Drill bit with wrong diameter is not accepted for the plug
Unknown product number is rejected, never shown as a product
Picture on brick: 5 kg → nail hooks; 10 kg → hooks invalid, drilled wall plugs
Shelf: 10 kg → brackets P058; 18 kg → previous choice invalid, safety stop
Product override kept across a load change is re-checked
4 plugs rated 15 kg each never carry 30 kg; every part must carry the whole load
40 kg on plasterboard → blocked with alternative
Load over 50 kg → blocked, professional
Products that require a professional are never selected
NUE-REG does not carry P059 (empty aisle) → aisle, shelf and stock stay empty
Rendered list for NUE-REG shows 'not available' for the missing aisle, never a number
German mode shows product_name_de from the catalogue; English mode the English name
Detector and wall notices (EN + DE) contain no clearance phrase and state the limits
Every drilling or nailing list carries the detector notice
Generated text claiming 'safe to drill' is discarded
Hint 'goggles not necessary' is dropped; safety_note shown unchanged
Rendered list shows the safety_note text exactly as in the catalogue
Injected instructions in product data change nothing and render as plain text
Unclear pack size (empty, 0, 2.5, text) → no pack count, no total
Rendered list shows 'no total' text instead of an amount
Stores have different data; each list shows only its own store's aisle and stock
Without store: identical products, checks and total; aisle/shelf/stock 'not available'
Values with status 'observed' (from text/speech) are not used until confirmed by tap
Electrics, gas, load-bearing walls and hidden pipes are detected (EN + DE)
Every chosen product has an evidence entry with catalogue source and rule ID
Catalogue lookup < 1 s and list generation < 5 s
Mock mode: valid answer → intent + values, all as guesses
Invalid answers are discarded: no JSON, extra field (product IDs), bad values, unknown intent
Invalid AI answer → templates offered, typed text and recognised values kept (as guesses)
AI network error / timeout / HTTP 500 in proxy mode → fallback, max. 2 attempts
Proxy request carries only redacted text and language – no PLZ, no catalogue
High-risk text is refused before and independent of the AI (even if the AI says 'shelf')
Recognised values are asked back pre-filled as guesses; max. 3 questions; list only after confirmation
Instructions in user text are data: 'confirmed' claims do not confirm anything
Unsupported or unclear text → hint and the template buttons
Numbers and units in German and English (words and digits)
Microphone only after explicit consent; language de-DE / en-US; interim results on
Live transcript appears in the editable field at once; nothing is processed before the tap
Misheard load (60 kg instead of 20 kg) is shown as a guess and never used without confirmation
Microphone denied → hint; typing and project buttons keep working
Unsupported browser, missing microphone, network error and start failure all fall back to typing
High-risk request by voice is refused exactly like typed input
Spoken 'commands' are only text: nothing is sent, confirmed or skipped
Leaving the screen or switching language ends the recording (abort)
Dictated numbers and units in German and English
speech.js never records, stores or sends audio itself
PLZ reference table loaded and store coordinates match their PLZ centre
Invalid or unknown PLZ never selects a store; message and the full store list appear
Valid PLZ with only one store in range still needs a tap; no store near you → message + full list
Stores are sorted by distance and limited by config; selection only by tap
Store search under 1 second
The PLZ is never sent to the AI and never written to the evidence log
From the list: 'Add postcode' → choose store → same list with that store's aisles
Missing PLZ table or store sheets → app continues without a store
P044 out of stock in Erlangen-Ost → stays on the list, referral to Erlangen West
Product not carried in any store → 'please ask staff', no substitute
Nürnberg-Leyh has everything → aisles of that store, no referral text
Referral names the nearest store with qty > 0; a store with qty 0 is never suggested
An unavailable part is never removed or replaced: same items, products and total in every store
A referral shows only the other store's name and distance – never its aisle, shelf or stock
Valid PLZ 91056: stores sorted by distance, Erlangen West first – but NOT preselected (team decision)
List labels estimates, sample data, rule IDs and states that rules – not AI – made it (EN + DE)
Every UI text exists in English and German
Stop rules use the catalogue IDs ST-01…ST-14; how-to links only for PRJ-05…09, https and allow-listed
Wall cabinet on concrete: 30 kg → 1 rail + 4 heavy-duty plugs; 45 kg and 110 cm → 2 rails + 8 anchor bolts, no extra screws
Plasterboard cabinet limit from the table: 70 × 35 cm → 16.5 kg (next smaller width, next larger depth)
Cabinet: aerated concrete, width > 120, depth > 60, height < 30 or > 100 → stop with catalogue text
Anti-tip: 1 kit up to 90 cm, 2 above; plasterboard only with cavity anchors (P046)
Paint 14 m × 2.5 m: 35 m² × 2 coats ÷ 7 m²/l = 10 l → 1 × 10 l; colour paint 2.5 l → 4 buckets; no wall or load questions
Paint: small mould → remover, anti-mould paint and gloves; large mould, allergy or old coating → professional
Wallpaper: 14 m × 2.5 m → 27 strips, 3 per roll → 9 rolls, 2 packs of paste; pattern repeat lengthens the strips
Wallpaper: damp wall stops, old wallpaper only warns
Glass door: hinge set rated ≥ 1.25 × door weight from the catalogue; own ESG door is not counted; ST-11 stops
Lock: type and size must match (PZ 55/72 → P093 + cylinder, WC 55/78 → P092); other sizes and outer doors stop
Sliding door on concrete: leaf ≥ opening, rail ≥ 2 × leaf; plug count 'per rail instructions' → no total; ST-13, R-12
Owned parts: tools and brackets can be ticked off, plugs and screws never; defect → part stays on the list (ST-06)
A stop rule that cannot be evaluated stops; an unknown condition in a stop rule stops
Shelf: solid brick uses brick plugs; brick of unknown type max. 25 kg; aerated concrete → ST-02
Keywords find the new projects and wall types (EN + DE); 'solid brick' wins over 'brick'
Board missing in the requested size (catalogue copy without P104): stop names the size, not the load (EN + DE)
Shelf 100 cm, 10 kg → 120 cm board (P103 25 cm deep, P104 20 cm deep) with 3 brackets; 80 cm keeps P064 / P063
Sliding door: leaf ≥ opening + 3 cm overlap per side and at the top; leaf ≤ free wall; 90 or 100 cm leaf
Size stop in cm: needed vs. available (EN + DE number format), one hand-off to store staff
Load 'I don't know' → stop (fact unknown) in every project with a load question; no plugs, no list
Basic projects get the high-risk filter too: 'paint the wall and move the socket' → professional stop
Checklist question: nothing ticked → error; 'none' → [] confirmed; a defect is stored as ticked
'I already have this' takes a tool off the total; no button for plugs and screws; 'need it' brings it back
Stop screen shows the catalogue text and hand-off (EN + DE), never a list
How-to links: https + allow-listed host only, open in a new tab without referrer; German content labelled in EN
Project buttons: 9 projects in 3 groups with icon and safety level
